headline: President Trump ended the Presidential Advisory Commission on Election Integrity with this January 2018 executive order.
what_it_does: This order shut down the Presidential Advisory Commission on Election Integrity. That was a federal advisory panel set up earlier to study issues related to elections. The order ended the commission's existence and its work.

who_it_affects.group: Members and staff of the Presidential Advisory Commission on Election Integrity
who_it_affects.how: Their commission was ended, so they no longer served on or worked for it.
